description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller for managing product prices within an admin interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product prices associated with products in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductPriceController
classes.description: The controller class responsible for handling product pricing operations in the admin section.

methods.name: getProductPrices
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the pricing page for a specific product, validating access and product existence.

methods.name: pagePrices
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide paginated product price data in JSON format for frontend display.

methods.name: editProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to edit a specific product price, loading current data into the form.

methods.name: displayCreateProductPrice
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a form for creating a new product price.

methods.name: displayProductPrice
methods.description: Prepares data to display in the product price form, either for editing or creating new prices.

methods.name: saveProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update product price data after form submission, including validation.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specified product price.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the view.
